verdict.rationale: Linear Loops let users describe a job in plain language and have it run in response to an event, and Loops now respond to changes in initiatives, projects and cycles. A documented example has a target-date change automatically update the launch plan and post a Slack message. Developers can also build event-driven automation via webhooks that push create/update/remove events, and PR workflow automation is offered through the GitHub integration. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how rule conditions and triggers are configured, a full list of supported trigger events, and independent or hands-on corroboration that Loops fire reliably.
